questions.question: What do Megumi and Panda do?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro & Panda vs. Kirara Hoshi

answer.item: They form a plan to ensure that Yuji's meeting with Hakari goes well by covering the door and keeping an eye on the situation

questions.question: What is the issue?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro & Panda vs. Kirara Hoshi

answer.item: The issue is Kirara and their cursed technique, which has always prevented Panda from approaching to the monitor room door

questions.question: What does Kirara realize?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro & Panda vs. Kirara Hoshi

answer.item: They associate Megumi and Panda with Jujutsu High, making Kirara realize that Yuji must be with Jujutsu High as well

questions.question: What happens when Divine Dog touches Kirara?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro & Panda vs. Kirara Hoshi

answer.item: as soon as Divine Dog makes the slightest contact with Kirara, its sent directly back at Megumi

questions.question: What does Megumi guess?
questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro & Panda vs. Kirara Hoshi

questions.question: What does Kirara do to the car?

questions.question: What does Megumi find on the roof?

answer.item: Megumi finds a parking stop charged with third-party cursed energy and sees its marked with ★Mimosa before touching it

questions.subject: Megumi Fushiguro & Panda vs. Kirara Hoshi

answer.item: Divine Dog: Totality suddenly reappears behind Kirara and grabs them

questions.question: What does Kirara say?

answer.item: Hakari is already onto Yuji and he kicks him out onto the roof
